query: EV heat pumps customs classification duties

statements.text: The applicable subheading of the Heat Pump and Air Handler unit, when imported and distributed together as the 16SEER2 Series split air conditioning system, will be 8415.10.6000, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS)

Pursuant to U.S. Note 20 to Subchapter III, Chapter 99, HTSUS, products of China classified under subheading 8415.10.6000, HTSUS, unless specifically excluded, are subject to an additional 25 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
The applicable subheading for the Heat Pump, model numbers COT-24CNVR1-18, COT-36CNVR1-18, COT-48CNVR1-18, and COT-60CNVR1-18, when imported separately, will be 8415.90.8065, HTSUS

Pursuant to U.S. Note 20 to Subchapter III, Chapter 99, HTSUS, products of China classified under subheading 8415.90.8065, HTSUS, unless specifically excluded, are subject to an additional 7.5 percent ad valorem rate of duty.
